title: Characterizing population movement patterns during a Sudan Virus Disease outbreak to adjust response efforts, Uganda, 2022.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: In September 2022, Uganda declared a Sudan virus disease outbreak in Mubende District. The Uganda Ministry of Health sought to characterize population movement patterns to identify areas at heightened transmission risk and guide outbreak response efforts. METHODS: From September to December 2022, response teams adapted the Population Connectivity Across Borders (PopCAB) method to conduct focus group discussions, key informant interviews, and participatory mapping with case-contacts and community members across three districts. Results characterizing local and cross-border travel routes and reasons for travel were applied to adjust response actions. RESULTS: Participants identified 69 locations across seven non-contiguous districts, including healthcare facilities, gold mines, schools, and transportation hubs linked to travel for trade, farming, healthcare, and family visits. Ministry of Health response teams used the results to enhance surveillance, risk communication, and infection prevention measures at priority locations including cross-border areas. Surveillance activities adjusted by the PopCAB results directly detected two cases in Kampala and indirectly identified 26 additional cases in newly targeted districts. CONCLUSIONS: Integrating community-based mobility mapping into contact tracing enabled rapid identification of high-risk areas beyond the outbreak epicenter. Response teams in similar settings can rapidly deploy this approach to generate real-time mobility data, improve resource allocation, and strengthen communicable disease containment efforts.

abstract_zh: OBJECTIVES: 在2022年9月,乌干达在穆本德区宣布爆发暴发苏丹病毒病。乌干达卫生部希望描述人口流动模式,以识别高传播风险区域并指导暴发应对措施。METHODS: 2022年9月至12月期间,应对团队调整了跨边界人口连通性(PopCAB)方法,与三个区的病例接触者和社区成员进行了焦点小组讨论、关键信息人访谈和参与式地图绘制。结果描述了本地和跨境旅行路线及旅行原因,用于调整应对行动。RESULTS: 参与者确定了七个不连续区中的69个地点,包括医疗设施、金矿、学校和与贸易、农业、医疗和家庭访问相关的交通枢纽。卫生部应对团队利用这些结果,在优先地点(包括跨境地区)加强了监测、风险沟通和感染预防措施。根据PopCAB结果调整的监测活动直接在坎帕拉发现了2例病例,并间接识别了新目标区中的另外26例病例。CONCLUSIONS: 将基于社区的移动性地图整合到接触追踪中,使快速识别出暴发疫区以外的高风险区域成为可能。在类似环境中,应对团队可以迅速部署这种方法,以生成实时移动性数据,改善资源分配,并加强传染病防控工作。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the epidemiology and clinical characteristics of Ebola virus outbreaks to better understand the disease burden and improve public health responses.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in multiple outbreak-affected regions and included patients diagnosed with Ebola virus disease during the specified time period.
analysis.methods: The researchers used clinical data and laboratory confirmation to identify cases and analyzed the transmission patterns and demographic factors associated with the outbreaks.
analysis.main_results: The study reported a total of 120 confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease, with a case fatality rate of 75% and a peak incidence during the first month of the outbreak.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the severity of the disease and the rapid progression of outbreaks, providing novel insights into the clinical and epidemiological features of the virus.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform targeted surveillance and intervention strategies to mitigate the spread and impact of Ebola virus disease in affected communities.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational nature and potential biases in case reporting, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study on the Ebola Virus Outbreak focuses on understanding the epidemiology and clinical characteristics of the disease. It reports 120 confirmed cases with a 75% case fatality rate, emphasizing the severity and rapid progression of outbreaks. The findings provide novel insights into the clinical and epidemiological features of the virus, which can inform targeted surveillance and intervention strategies. However, the study's observational design and potential biases limit the confidence in its conclusions, resulting in a moderate evidence strength assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 流行病学 和 埃博拉病毒 暴发 的临床特征,以更好地了解疾病负担并改进公共卫生应对措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在多个 暴发 受影响地区进行,并包括在指定时间段内被诊断为 埃博拉病毒病 的患者。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员利用临床数据和实验室确认来识别病例,并分析 传播 模式及与 暴发 相关的流行病学因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 本研究报告了总共 120 例 埃博拉病毒病 确诊病例,病死率为 75%,且在 暴发 的第一个月内达到高峰。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现突显了该疾病的严重性以及 暴发 的快速进展,为病毒的临床和流行病学特征提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果可以为针对性的 监测 和干预策略提供信息,以减少 埃博拉病毒病 在受影响社区中的传播和影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于研究的观察性质以及病例报告中的潜在偏倚,研究结果的置信度评估为中等。

title: The welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of an index case of Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease reported in Kenya on 6 October 2026
abstract: Abstract Introduction: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (EBVD) was imported into Kenya from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 3 October 2026. Economic evidence is lacking to inform Kenya’s Ministry of Health’s advocacy for domestic and external investment to bolster prevention, mitigation, preparedness, and response to EBVD. This study aimed to estimate, from an economy-wide (societal) perspective, the discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya on 6 October 2026. Methods Drawing on various secondary sources, this study uses the human capital approach (HCA), the willingness-to-pay small (WTP_S) and large (WTP_L) models, and the willingness-to-accept small (WTA_S) and large (WTA_L) models to estimate discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya. To assess the robustness of the results, the five models were each re-estimated four times, assuming (i) a 5% discount rate, (ii) a 10% discount rate, (iii) Africa’s highest male average life expectancy at birth, 74.55 years in Tunisia, and (iv) the world’s highest male average life expectancy, 84.78 years in Monaco. Results Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Using the implied WTP approach, the expected welfare loss would be between Int$423,302 and Int$786,133, with a productivity loss of between Int$142,669 and Int$264,957. Applying the implied WTA approach yields a welfare loss of Int$1,269,907 to Int$4,051,608 and a productivity loss of Int$428,007 to Int$1,365,546. Re-estimating the HCA, WTP_S, WTP_L, WTA_S, and WTA_L models with 5% and 10% discount rates reduced the estimated welfare and productivity losses by about 17% and 45%, respectively. Re-running the welfare and productivity loss models with Africa's and the world’s highest male life expectancies increased the welfare loss estimates by about 35% and 54%, respectively. Conclusions The death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya will likely lead to significant welfare and productivity losses. Kenya’s Ministry of Health should continue advocacy with the whole-of-government, the private sector, civil society, and development partners to urgently increase investment to bridge gaps in International Health Regulations core capacities, universal health coverage, and WASH (water, sanitation, and hygiene), thereby mitigating the risk of EBVD becoming a national epidemic.

analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in Kenya, focusing on the economic impact of the death of the index case of EBVD on 6 October 2026. It used a societal perspective to assess the losses.
analysis_en.methods: The study employed the human capital approach (HCA), willingness-to-pay small (WTP_S) and large (WTP_L) models, and willingness-to-accept small (WTA_S) and large (WTA_L) models to estimate the discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD.
analysis_en.main_results: Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Re-estimating the models with different discount rates and life expectancies showed variations in the estimated losses.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as indicating that the death of the index case of EBVD would lead to significant welfare and productivity losses, highlighting the need for economic assessments in public health responses.

title_zh: 肯尼亚2026年10月6日报告的埃博拉邦迪布古病毒病索引病例死亡所关联的福利和生产力损失
source_body_en: Abstract Introduction: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (EBVD) was imported into Kenya from the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 3 October 2026. Economic evidence is lacking to inform Kenya’s Ministry of Health’s advocacy for domestic and external investment to bolster prevention, mitigation, preparedness, and response to EBVD. This study aimed to estimate, from an economy-wide (societal) perspective, the discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya on 6 October 2026. Methods Drawing on various secondary sources, this study uses the human capital approach (HCA), the willingness-to-pay small (WTP_S) and large (WTP_L) models, and the willingness-to-accept small (WTA_S) and large (WTA_L) models to estimate discounted welfare and productivity losses associated with the death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya. To assess the robustness of the results, the five models were each re-estimated four times, assuming (i) a 5% discount rate, (ii) a 10% discount rate, (iii) Africa’s highest male average life expectancy at birth, 74.55 years in Tunisia, and (iv) the world’s highest male average life expectancy, 84.78 years in Monaco. Results Under the HCA model, the death of the 40-year-old male patient is expected to result in a total welfare loss of Int$120,944 and a productivity loss of Int$40,763. Using the implied WTP approach, the expected welfare loss would be between Int$423,302 and Int$786,133, with a productivity loss of between Int$142,669 and Int$264,957. Applying the implied WTA approach yields a welfare loss of Int$1,269,907 to Int$4,051,608 and a productivity loss of Int$428,007 to Int$1,365,546. Re-estimating the HCA, WTP_S, WTP_L, WTA_S, and WTA_L models with 5% and 10% discount rates reduced the estimated welfare and productivity losses by about 17% and 45%, respectively. Re-running the welfare and productivity loss models with Africa's and the world’s highest male life expectancies increased the welfare loss estimates by about 35% and 54%, respectively. Conclusions The death of the index case of EBVD in Kenya will likely lead to significant welfare and productivity losses. Kenya’s Ministry of Health should continue advocacy with the whole-of-government, the private sector, civil society, and development partners to urgently increase investment to bridge gaps in International Health Regulations core capacities, universal health coverage, and WASH (water, sanitation, and hygiene), thereby mitigating the risk of EBVD becoming a national epidemic.
abstract_zh: 摘要 引言:埃博拉邦迪布古病毒病(EBVD)于2026年10月3日从刚果民主共和国传入肯尼亚。目前缺乏经济证据来支持肯尼亚卫生部在公共卫生领域倡导国内和国际投资以加强EBVD的预防、缓解、准备和响应能力。本研究旨在从全社会视角估算肯尼亚2026年10月6日报告的EBVD索引病例死亡所导致的折现后的福利和生产力损失。方法 本研究借鉴多种二次资料来源,采用人力资本方法(HCA)、意愿支付小(WTP_S)和大(WTP_L)模型,以及意愿接受小(WTA_S)和大(WTA_L)模型,以估算肯尼亚EBVD索引病例死亡所导致的折现后的福利和生产力损失。为评估结果的稳健性,每种模型均在四种假设下重新估算:(i)5%的折现率,(ii)10%的折现率,(iii)非洲男性最高出生时平均预期寿命74.55年(突尼斯),(iv)世界男性最高出生时平均预期寿命84.78年(摩纳哥)。结果 在HCA模型下,40岁男性患者的死亡预计会导致总福利损失Int$120,944和生产力损失Int$40,763。使用隐含意愿支付方法,预计福利损失范围为Int$423,302至Int$786,133,生产力损失范围为Int$142,669至Int$264,957。应用隐含意愿接受方法,预计福利损失为Int$1,269,907至Int$4,051,608,生产力损失为Int$428,007至Int$1,365,546。使用5%和10%的折现率重新估算HCA、WTP_S、WTP_L、WTA_S和WTA_L模型,分别使福利和生产力损失的估算减少了约17%和45%。使用非洲和世界最高男性预期寿命重新运行福利和生产力损失模型,使福利损失的估算分别增加了约35%和54%。结论 肯尼亚EBVD索引病例的死亡很可能会导致显著的福利和生产力损失。肯尼亚卫生部应继续与政府各部门、私营部门、民间社会和开发伙伴合作,紧急增加投资以弥补国际卫生条例核心能力、全民健康覆盖和水、卫生与环境卫生(WASH)方面的差距,从而降低EBVD成为全国性流行病的风险。

title: Known pathogen, unprepared system: Bundibugyo virus and the diagnostic preparedness gap
abstract: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exposed a fundamental weakness in global diagnostic preparedness. Although BDBV had been recognized for nearly two decades and diagnostic tools existed, gaps across the diagnostic ecosystem delayed outbreak recognition and response. Scientific capability existed, but a resilient diagnostic ecosystem capable of translating existing technologies into timely public health action was lacking. The response to the BDBV outbreak should be understood not as an isolated diagnostic failure, but as a case study demonstrating why preparedness strategies built around individual pathogens are insufficient for future epidemic and pandemic threats. Diagnostic preparedness must shift toward adaptable syndromic and viral-family platforms, regional sequencing capacity, integrated surveillance systems, pre-positioned regulatory and validation pathways, resilient manufacturing, sustainable inter-epidemic financing, and clear global accountability. The outbreak raises broader questions. If the global community struggles to deploy diagnostics for a known pathogen, it is unlikely to respond effectively to a novel or highly divergent one. Building a fit-for-purpose diagnostic preparedness ecosystem is essential for achieving the 100 Days Mission and future pandemic preparedness.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the 2026 Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, highlighting a critical gap in global diagnostic preparedness. Despite BDBV being recognized for nearly two decades, the diagnostic ecosystem failed to translate existing technologies into timely public health action. The authors argue that the response to this outbreak should be viewed as a case study illustrating the inadequacy of pathogen-specific preparedness strategies for future threats. While the findings are based on a single case study, they provide important insights into the limitations of current diagnostic preparedness and the importance of systemic improvements.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2026年刚果民主共和国发生的邦迪布古病毒(BDBV)暴发暴露出全球诊断准备体系中的根本性弱点。尽管BDBV已被识别近二十年,且存在诊断工具,但诊断生态系统中的差距导致了暴发的识别和应对延迟。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是对2026年刚果民主共和国发生的邦迪布古病毒暴发的案例研究。它通过分析对这一暴发的应对情况,探讨诊断准备不足的差距。
elements_zh.methods: 诊断准备必须转向适应性强的综合征和病毒家族平台,区域基因组测序能力,整合的监测系统,预先部署的监管和验证路径,韧性制造,可持续的流行间资金支持,以及明确的全球问责机制。
elements_zh.main_results: 对BDBV 暴发的应对不应被理解为一次孤立的诊断失败,而应被视为一个案例研究,说明以单个病原体为中心的准备策略不足以应对未来的流行病和大流行威胁。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 如果全球社会难以对已知病原体部署诊断工具,那么对于新出现或高度变异的病原体,很可能无法有效应对。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 暴发引发了关于为何需要一个更具韧性和适应性的诊断生态系统来应对未来流行病和大流行威胁的更广泛问题。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告研究的具体局限性,但总体含义表明,由于依赖单一案例研究,证据强度中等。

title: The Attenuation Paradox in Bundibugyo Virus Disease: Case Fatality, Ascertainment, and Delayed Outbreak Recognition
abstract: Bundibugyo virus has caused three recognised outbreaks, and each was recognised late. The usual reading of that record treats the delay as a failure of investment, diagnostics or governance. This review sets out a partly mechanistic alternative: the low case fatality ratio observed early in a Bundibugyo virus outbreak is itself one of the conditions that produces the delay, and the delay in turn depresses the observed ratio further. The evidence is organised around three comparison tables: the burden, severity and recognition interval of each outbreak; the presenting clinical features set against a matched Ebola virus series; and the point at which species assignment failed in each event. A schematic draws the relationships together. Two findings emerge. The clinical syndrome does not discriminate between species: haemorrhage was documented in roughly a quarter of confirmed patients in both the 2007–08 Bundibugyo series and a 2014 Ebola virus series, so the presenting picture cannot carry the explanatory weight often placed on it. The discriminating failures are instead genomic and diagnostic, and the early case fatality ratio operates as a surveillance trigger that is biased downward precisely when ascertainment is narrowest. The 2026 epidemic, in which the confirmed ratio rose from 12.1% to 44.3% while the virus doubled every 5.5 days, fits this account better than it fits a change in virulence. A fatality ratio from the first weeks of a filovirus outbreak should therefore be read as an index of surveillance maturity rather than of danger, and escalation should be governed by species-inclusive confirmation.
journal: Sebha University Journal of Medical Sciences

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the attenuation paradox in Bundibugyo virus disease, focusing on the delayed recognition of outbreaks and the low case fatality ratio observed early in these events. It challenges the conventional interpretation that delays are due to failures in investment, diagnostics, or governance, proposing instead that the low fatality ratio itself contributes to delayed outbreak recognition. abstract_zh: 邦迪布古病毒已引发三次被确认的暴发,且每次均被延迟确认。通常对这一记录的解读将延迟归因于投资、诊断或治理的失败。本文提出了一种部分机制性的替代观点:在邦迪布古病毒暴发初期观察到的低病例死亡率本身就是导致延迟的一个条件,而延迟反过来又进一步压低了观察到的死亡率。证据围绕三个比较表格组织:每次暴发的负担、严重程度和识别间隔;临床表现与匹配的埃博拉病毒系列进行对比;以及每次事件中物种分类失败的时间点。一个示意图将这些关系整合在一起。两个主要发现浮现。临床综合征无法区分物种:在2007–08年的邦迪布古系列和2014年的埃博拉病毒系列中,大约四分之一的确认患者都出现了出血现象,因此初始表现无法承担通常赋予它的解释权重。区分失败则源于基因组和诊断层面,而早期病例死亡率比率在确认范围最狭窄时会向下偏倚,从而充当监测的触发因素。2026年的疫情中,确认死亡率从12.1%上升至44.3%,同时病毒每5.5天翻倍一次,这比将其归因于病毒毒力变化更符合这一解释。因此,从丝状病毒暴发初期几周内获得的死亡率比率应被解读为监测成熟度的指标,而非危险程度,而疫情升级应由包含所有物种的确认来指导。

title: Measurement Error Correction and Multidimensional Aggregation in Epidemiological Surveillance Systems: Application to the Ebola Virus Disease Epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
abstract: Epidemiological surveillance systems produce decision-making indicators from data that may be affected by under-reporting, misclassification and notification delays. These errors can propagate through the extraction, transformation, loading and multidimensional aggregation stages. This article proposes a mathematical framework that integrates measurement error correction into an ETL–data warehouse–OLAP decision architecture. The central problem is to determine whether the correction of a misclassification error can be performed before or after aggregation without changing the resulting indicator. We show that the Rogan–Gladen estimator commutes with the roll-up operator only when the sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across the aggregated strata. A numerical instantiation based on a synthetic dataset calibrated on published parameters of the Ebola virus disease epidemic in North Kivu and Ituri (DRC, 2018–2020) illustrates this non-commutation and its consequences for the estimation of incidence and the reproduction number. These results lead to a design rule: when surveillance quality is heterogeneous, correction must be performed at the finest level at which the error parameters can be regarded as homogeneous, before any aggregation, because this is the only strategy that remains unbiased whatever the spatial distribution of cases. A bias–variance analysis (Theorem 4) and a Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis (5,000 replicates, seven scenarios) further show that aggregate-level correction can have a slightly smaller variance but becomes biased when cases concentrate in poorly covered zones, and that the corrected indicators are highly sensitive to the assumed specificity when test positivity is close to the false-positive floor (a misspecification of 0.005 in specificity changes cumulative incidence by more than 100%). No individual-level surveillance data were used: the synthetic data are fully specified by a generation algorithm and a parameter table provided for reproducibility. The proposed framework thus provides a formal basis for designing surveillance decision-support systems that explicitly account for data quality.
journal: Asian Journal of Research in Computer Science

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the challenge of measurement error in epidemiological surveillance systems, particularly in the context of Ebola virus disease. It presents a mathematical framework that integrates error correction into an ETL–data warehouse–OLAP architecture, aiming to improve the accuracy of decision-making indicators. The research demonstrates that the Rogan–Gladen estimator only commutes with the roll-up operator when sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across aggregated strata. A synthetic dataset based on the DRC Ebola epidemic illustrates the consequences of error correction at different stages. The authors conclude that correction should occur at the finest level where error parameters are homogeneous to ensure unbiased results. The study highlights the importance of accounting for data quality in surveillance systems and provides a formal basis for their design. However, the use of synthetic data limits the applicability of findings to real-world scenarios, and the framework's effectiveness depends on assumptions about test specificity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 流行病学监测系统从可能受漏报、误分类和通报延迟影响的数据中生成决策指标。这些误差可能在提取、转换、加载和多维聚合阶段传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本文提出了一种数学框架,将测量误差校正整合到ETL-数据仓库-OLAP决策架构中。核心问题是确定是否可以在聚合之前或之后校正误分类误差,而不会改变最终的指标结果。
elements_zh.methods: 基于北基伏和伊图里地区(刚果民主共和国,2018–2020年)埃博拉病毒病疫情的已发表参数校准的合成数据集的数值实例说明了这种非交换性及其对发病率估计和再生数的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们证明了Rogan–Gladen估计器仅在敏感性和特异性参数在聚合分层中保持同质时,才能与roll-up操作符交换。偏差-方差分析(定理4)和蒙特卡洛不确定性分析(5,000次重复,七个场景)进一步表明,聚合层级的校正可能具有略微较小的方差,但当病例集中在覆盖不足的区域时会变得有偏,且校正后的指标在测试阳性率接近假阳性下限时对假设的特异性高度敏感(特异性假设误差0.005会导致累计发病率变化超过100%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些结果引导出一个设计规则:当监测质量不均时,校正必须在误差参数可视为同质的最细粒度层级上进行,然后再进行任何聚合,因为这是唯一一种无论病例空间分布如何都能保持无偏的策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 所提出的框架为设计明确考虑数据质量的监测决策支持系统提供了正式的基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 未使用个体层面的监测数据:合成数据完全由一个生成算法和一个用于可重复性的参数表指定。

title_zh: 流行病学监测系统中的测量误差校正与多维聚合:应用于刚果民主共和国埃博拉病毒病疫情
source_body_en: Epidemiological surveillance systems produce decision-making indicators from data that may be affected by under-reporting, misclassification and notification delays. These errors can propagate through the extraction, transformation, loading and multidimensional aggregation stages. This article proposes a mathematical framework that integrates measurement error correction into an ETL–data warehouse–OLAP decision architecture. The central problem is to determine whether the correction of a misclassification error can be performed before or after aggregation without changing the resulting indicator. We show that the Rogan–Gladen estimator commutes with the roll-up operator only when the sensitivity and specificity parameters are homogeneous across the aggregated strata. A numerical instantiation based on a synthetic dataset calibrated on published parameters of the Ebola virus disease epidemic in North Kivu and Ituri (DRC, 2018–2020) illustrates this non-commutation and its consequences for the estimation of incidence and the reproduction number. These results lead to a design rule: when surveillance quality is heterogeneous, correction must be performed at the finest level at which the error parameters can be regarded as homogeneous, before any aggregation, because this is the only strategy that remains unbiased whatever the spatial distribution of cases. A bias–variance analysis (Theorem 4) and a Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis (5,000 replicates, seven scenarios) further show that aggregate-level correction can have a slightly smaller variance but becomes biased when cases concentrate in poorly covered zones, and that the corrected indicators are highly sensitive to the assumed specificity when test positivity is close to the false-positive floor (a misspecification of 0.005 in specificity changes cumulative incidence by more than 100%). No individual-level surveillance data were used: the synthetic data are fully specified by a generation algorithm and a parameter table provided for reproducibility. The proposed framework thus provides a formal basis for designing surveillance decision-support systems that explicitly account for data quality.
abstract_zh: 流行病学监测系统从可能受漏报、误分类和通报延迟影响的数据中生成决策指标。这些误差可能在提取、转换、加载和多维聚合阶段传播。本文提出了一种数学框架,将测量误差校正整合到ETL-数据仓库-OLAP决策架构中。核心问题是确定是否可以在聚合之前或之后校正误分类误差,而不会改变最终的指标结果。我们证明了Rogan–Gladen估计器仅在敏感性和特异性参数在聚合分层中保持同质时,才能与roll-up操作符交换。基于北基伏和伊图里地区(刚果民主共和国,2018–2020年)埃博拉病毒病疫情的已发表参数校准的合成数据集的数值实例说明了这种非交换性及其对发病率估计和再生数的影响。这些结果引导出一个设计规则:当监测质量不均时,校正必须在误差参数可视为同质的最细粒度层级上进行,然后再进行任何聚合,因为这是唯一一种无论病例空间分布如何都能保持无偏的策略。偏差-方差分析(定理4)和蒙特卡洛不确定性分析(5,000次重复,七个场景)进一步表明,聚合层级的校正可能具有略微较小的方差,但当病例集中在覆盖不足的区域时会变得有偏,且校正后的指标在测试阳性率接近假阳性下限时对假设的特异性高度敏感(特异性假设误差0.005会导致累计发病率变化超过100%)。未使用个体层面的监测数据:合成数据完全由一个生成算法和一个用于可重复性的参数表指定。因此,所提出的框架为设计明确考虑数据质量的监测决策支持系统提供了正式的基础。

title: Natural genus-exclusive four-position VP24 configuration in Bundibugyo virus links host interferon tone to a testable cell-type ordering
abstract: Abstract Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) causes outbreaks with lower case-fatality than Ebola virus (EBOV); its VP24 carries the only BDBV-specific functional difference mapped to date. That difference was defined in an engineered virus. Here, we integrate a sequence census, a human cell-type expression atlas, and a reanalysis of public infection data to connect the natural BDBV VP24 configuration to host interferon (IFN) tone and derive a testable cell-type ordering of post-entry IFN-mediated restriction. All 31 full-length BDBV VP24 records and all 36 complete 2026 outbreak genomes carried S83/Q135/H140/A141; none of the other five orthoebolavirus species assessed carried the complete set. Two consensus-only single-position departures occurred among 860 callable copies in the surveillance data. Δ, a baseline IFN-tone score, tracks the IFN-stimulated level attained by a cell and predicts the strength of IFN-mediated suppression of viral RNA accumulation in cells infected with BDBV carrying the VP24 defect: high Δ denotes stronger suppression, low Δ weaker. Across 154 human cell types, Δ was higher in surface epithelia and circulating myeloid cells (enterocytes 1.28; monocytes 1.00) than in retinal and testicular cells (retinal pigment epithelium − 1.02; Sertoli cells − 0.68). A competing importin-α model predicted exemption in the 47 cell types with high Δ but low importin-α, including enteric epithelium and hepatocytes. In the HIV-1 restriction panel, Δ discriminated restricted from permissive cells (area under the curve (AUC) 0.87), whereas importin-α was at chance (AUC 0.47–0.50); functional data therefore descriptively support Δ.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the unique VP24 configuration in Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) and its association with host interferon (IFN) tone. The research aimed to connect the natural BDBV VP24 configuration to IFN-mediated restriction in different human cell types. By integrating a sequence census, a human cell-type expression atlas, and reanalysis of public infection data, the study identified that all 31 full-length BDBV VP24 records and 36 complete 2026 outbreak genomes carried the S83/Q135/H140/A141 configuration, which is absent in other orthoebolavirus species. The findings revealed that Δ, a baseline IFN-tone score, correlates with the strength of IFN-mediated suppression of viral RNA accumulation. The study also demonstrated that Δ was higher in surface epithelia and circulating myeloid cells compared to retinal and testicular cells. Additionally, a competing importin-α model predicted exemption in certain cell types with high Δ but low importin-α. These results provide insights into the cell-type-specific restriction of BDBV and highlight the importance of IFN tone in viral dynamics. However, the study's interpretation is limited by the reliance on a competing model and the absence of direct functional validation.

abstract_zh: 摘要 巴迪布吉奥病毒(BDBV)导致暴发,其死亡率低于埃博拉病毒(埃博拉病毒,EBOV);其VP24携带目前唯一已映射的BDBV特异性功能差异。该差异是在一种工程病毒中定义的。在这里,我们整合了序列普查、人类细胞类型表达图谱以及对公共感染数据的重新分析,以将天然BDBV VP24构型与宿主干扰素(IFN)水平联系起来,并推导出一种可验证的细胞类型顺序,以描述病毒进入后的IFN介导的限制作用。所有31条完整的BDBV VP24序列记录以及所有36条完整的2026年暴发 基因组序列均携带S83/Q135/H140/A141;在评估的其他五个正乙脑病毒属(orthoebolavirus)物种中,没有携带完整组合的。在监测数据中,860条可调用的拷贝中出现了两个仅基于共识的单个位点变异。Δ,一个基础干扰素水平评分,追踪细胞所达到的干扰素刺激水平,并预测携带VP24缺陷的BDBV感染细胞中干扰素介导的病毒RNA积累抑制强度:高Δ表示更强的抑制,低Δ表示较弱的抑制。在154种人类细胞类型中,Δ在表面上皮细胞和循环髓系细胞(肠上皮细胞1.28;单核细胞1.00)中高于在视网膜和睾丸细胞(视网膜色素上皮细胞−1.02;塞尔托利细胞−0.68)中。一个竞争性的进口素α模型预测,在Δ高但进口素α低的47种细胞类型中存在豁免,包括肠上皮细胞和肝细胞。在HIV-1限制图谱中,Δ能够区分受限细胞和允许细胞(曲线下面积(AUC)0.87),而进口素α则处于随机水平(AUC 0.47–0.50);因此,功能数据在描述上支持Δ。

title: Doxycycline and Nitazoxanide as a Candidate Immunomodulatory Combination for the Early Management of Ebola Disease Caused by Bundibugyo Virus
abstract: As of 5 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with close to two of every three deaths in an earlier WHO reporting interval occurring in communities rather than treatment centres. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021 I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute onset immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology now described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed a myeloid hyperinflammatory profile with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors transcripts of an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each acting on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man, and nitazoxanide amplifies the RIG-I and PKR arm the virus suppresses. To be noted that none of this establishes efficacy in Bundibugyo disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, with the host-directed concentration still unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. I strongly believe the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to explore potential immunomodulatory strategies for managing Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus, given the high mortality rate and lack of approved treatments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where as of 5 November 2026, there were 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with a significant proportion of deaths occurring in communities rather than treatment centers.
analysis.methods: The study analyzed pathology in Bundibugyo-infected macaques, identifying distinct immune profiles in fatal and survivor animals, and proposed a mechanism for doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an immunomodulatory combination.
analysis.main_results: Pathology in Bundibugyo-infected macaques showed that fatal cases had a myeloid hyperinflammatory profile with elevated interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, while survivors exhibited an intact T cell response.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as suggesting a potential immunomodulatory approach, proposing doxycycline and nitazoxanide as a combination targeting different immune pathways, based on the observed immune profiles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of understanding immune dysregulation in Bundibugyo virus disease and suggest a promising avenue for early immunomodulatory interventions, which could be critical for managing outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study does not establish efficacy in Bundibugyo disease, as it is based on observations in macaques and lacks direct clinical evidence, which limits the strength of the conclusions.

The findings suggest that focusing on immunomodulators may be a viable approach for addressing outbreaks, as these drugs are already available and inexpensive.

title_zh: 多西环素和尼替考酸胺作为布迪布古病毒所致埃博拉病早期管理的候选免疫调节联合用药
source_body_en: As of 5 November 2026, Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo had produced 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with close to two of every three deaths in an earlier WHO reporting interval occurring in communities rather than treatment centres. No vaccine or treatment is approved for this species, and the agents in trials are monoclonal antibodies and direct-acting antivirals. In 2021 I proposed reclassifying COVID-19, Ebola virus disease and Nipah virus infection as a novel acute onset immune dysrhythmia syndrome. Read through it, the pathology now described in Bundibugyo-infected macaques points to two arms: fatal animals showed a myeloid hyperinflammatory profile with raised interleukin-6 and myeloperoxidase, survivors transcripts of an intact T cell response. Basing on that convergence I propose doxycycline and nitazoxanide as an early immunomodulatory combination, each acting on a different arm. Doxycycline inhibits matrix metalloproteinases at exposures achievable in man, and nitazoxanide amplifies the RIG-I and PKR arm the virus suppresses. To be noted that none of this establishes efficacy in Bundibugyo disease. What it offers is a mechanism worth testing in two licensed, oral, inexpensive drugs on the shelf, with the host-directed concentration still unmeasured. I therefore ask for species-specific work: activity in relevant cells and in the macaque model, the unbound concentration-response relationship, and a two-by-two factorial evaluation, preclinical and clinical, powered for the interaction. I strongly believe the search for safe immunomodulators is the one most likely to end in a drug available on the day it is needed.

title: Cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus: search strategies and review methods
abstract: Companion file to a PROSPERO registration. Contains the complete, pre-specified search strategies for a systematic review of the cross-protective potential of Zaire ebolavirus (EBOV)-targeted vaccines against Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), together with the eligibility criteria and core methodological components of the review. title: Mechanism of Action Studies of Small Molecule Entry Inhibitors Targeting Filovirus Glycoproteins
abstract: Ebola virus (EBOV) and Marburg virus (MARV) are highly pathogenic filoviruses. Infection with either of these viruses results in viral hemorrhagic fever (VHF), a severe disease that can lead to multiorgan failure, internal bleeding, and, oftentimes, death. Currently, no antivirals are approved for the treatment of filoviruses, underscoring the urgent need for broad-spectrum antivirals. Currently, two vaccines are FDA-approved against EBOV disease; however, they are only effective against EBOV Zaire, while recent EBOV outbreaks have been caused by EBOV Sudan, underscoring the need for broad-spectrum vaccines and antivirals. Thus, our research goal is to develop small molecule inhibitors that directly target the filoviral glycoprotein (GP), which mediates viral entry into host cells for both EBOV and MARV. Our study is divided into two chapters: the development of broad-spectrum anti-filoviral entry inhibitors and the elucidation of the mechanisms of action (MOAs) of novel small molecule entry inhibitors.

title: Recent Advances in Experimental Models to Study Endotheliopathy in Viral Hemorrhagic Fevers: Relevance to Lassa Virus
abstract: Endothelial cells are a common target of several viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), including those caused by Lassa virus (LASV) and Ebola virus, yet whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy and inflammation in severe VHF remains unclear. Understanding these mechanisms requires experimental approaches that adequately capture the complexity of the vascular microenvironment. Here, we review recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on LASV and complementary recent evidence from other VHFs. We discuss endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. Although experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited, we propose that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. Drawing on mechanistic insights from other VHFs, we discuss potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions, including IL-6 trans-signaling, and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction during Lassa fever. Furthermore, we review recent advances in organ-on-chip and organoid technologies for modeling the human vasculature and investigating barrier function in the context of VHFs, considering the practical biosafety constraints of high-containment laboratories. Finally, we highlight experimental and methodological priorities for improving the physiological relevance and standardization of these models to enable future mechanistic studies of VHF-associated endotheliopathy.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on understanding the role of endothelial cells in the pathogenesis of viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), specifically examining whether endothelial infection drives the endotheliopathy underlying vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF. The central question is whether direct endothelial infection alone is sufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever, with a focus on Ebola viruses as the target entity.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of recent experimental advances in understanding endothelial involvement in VHF pathogenesis, with a focus on Ebola viruses and complementary evidence from other VHFs. It discusses experimental approaches such as endothelial cell infection in non-human primates and in vitro models, immune-endothelial crosstalk, and the effects of soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins on endothelial barrier integrity. The review does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction remains limited. However, it proposes that direct endothelial infection alone is insufficient to account for increased vascular permeability during Lassa fever. The findings are drawn from mechanistic insights from other VHFs, including the potential contributions of immune-endothelial interactions and soluble or surface-exposed viral proteins to vascular dysfunction.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that the mechanisms by which endothelial infection contributes to vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation in severe VHF remain unclear. It also notes that experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial cell activation and barrier dysfunction is limited, and there is a lack of standardized models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for experimental and methodological priorities to improve the physiological relevance and standardization of models for studying VHF-associated endotheliopathy. It suggests the development of more advanced organ-on-chip and organoid technologies to better model the human vasculature and investigate barrier function in the context of VHFs, while considering biosafety constraints.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the role of endothelial cells in the pathogenesis of viral hemorrhagic fevers (VHF), with a focus on Ebola viruses. It highlights the need for experimental models that capture the complexity of the vascular microenvironment to understand how endothelial infection contributes to vascular leakage, coagulopathy, and inflammation. The review notes that while experimental evidence for LASV-induced endothelial dysfunction is limited, immune-endothelial interactions and soluble viral proteins may play a significant role. It also discusses the potential of organ-on-chip and organoid technologies for modeling VHF-associated endotheliopathy and identifies methodological priorities for future research.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于理解病毒性出血热(VHF)中内皮细胞在发病机制中的作用,具体探讨内皮细胞感染是否驱动严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症背后的内皮病。核心问题是直接的内皮细胞感染是否足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加,重点以埃博拉病毒作为靶标实体。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对近期理解VHF 发病机制中内皮细胞参与的实验进展的叙述性综合,重点讨论了埃博拉病毒以及来自其他VHF的补充证据。它探讨了实验方法,如非人灵长类动物和体外模型中的内皮细胞感染,免疫-内皮细胞相互作用,以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对内皮屏障完整性的影响。综述未涉及荟萃分析或汇总估计。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,关于拉沙病毒(LASV)诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据仍有限。然而,它提出直接的内皮细胞感染不足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加。这些发现基于其他VHF的机制见解,包括免疫-内皮细胞相互作用和可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对血管功能障碍的潜在贡献。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,内皮细胞感染如何导致严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症的机制仍不清楚。它还指出,关于拉沙病毒诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据有限,且缺乏标准化模型用于研究VHF相关的内皮病。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调了改进研究VHF相关内皮病模型的生理相关性和标准化的实验与方法优先事项。它建议开发更先进的器官芯片和类器官技术,以更好地模拟人类血管系统并研究VHF背景下的屏障功能,同时考虑生物安全限制。}}.

abstract_zh: 内皮细胞是多种病毒性出血热(VHF)的常见靶标,包括由拉沙病毒(LASV)和埃博拉病毒引起的VHF,但内皮细胞感染是否驱动严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症背后的内皮病仍不清楚。理解这些机制需要能够充分反映血管微环境复杂性的实验方法。本文综述了近期在理解VHF 发病机制中内皮细胞参与方面的实验进展,重点讨论了拉沙病毒,并结合了其他VHF的相关证据。我们探讨了非人灵长类动物和体外模型中内皮细胞的感染情况,免疫-内皮细胞相互作用,以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对内皮屏障完整性的影响。尽管关于拉沙病毒诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据仍有限,但我们提出直接的内皮细胞感染不足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加。借鉴其他VHF的机制见解,我们讨论了免疫-内皮细胞相互作用(包括IL-6跨信号传导)以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对拉沙热期间血管功能障碍的潜在贡献。此外,我们回顾了近期在器官芯片和类器官技术方面的进展,用于模拟人类血管系统并研究VHF背景下屏障功能,同时考虑高安全等级实验室的实践生物安全限制。最后,我们强调了改进这些模型的生理相关性和标准化的实验与方法优先事项,以促进未来对VHF相关内皮病机制的研究。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于理解病毒性出血热(VHF)中内皮细胞在发病机制中的作用,具体探讨内皮细胞感染是否驱动严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症背后的内皮病。核心问题是直接的内皮细胞感染是否足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加,重点以埃博拉病毒作为靶标实体。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是对近期理解VHF 发病机制中内皮细胞参与的实验进展的叙述性综合,重点讨论了埃博拉病毒以及来自其他VHF的补充证据。它探讨了实验方法,如非人灵长类动物和体外模型中的内皮细胞感染,免疫-内皮细胞相互作用,以及可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对内皮屏障完整性的影响。综述未涉及荟萃分析或汇总估计。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论,关于拉沙病毒(LASV)诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据仍有限。然而,它提出直接的内皮细胞感染不足以解释拉沙热期间血管通透性的增加。这些发现基于其他VHF的机制见解,包括免疫-内皮细胞相互作用和可溶性或表面暴露的病毒蛋白对血管功能障碍的潜在贡献。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,内皮细胞感染如何导致严重VHF中血管渗漏、凝血功能障碍和炎症的机制仍不清楚。它还指出,关于拉沙病毒诱导的内皮细胞激活和屏障功能障碍的实验证据有限,且缺乏标准化模型用于研究VHF相关的内皮病。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调了改进研究VHF相关内皮病模型的生理相关性和标准化的实验与方法优先事项。它建议开发更先进的器官芯片和类器官技术,以更好地模拟人类血管系统并研究VHF背景下的屏障功能,同时考虑生物安全限制。}}.

title: National Ebola preparedness policy architecture and health system readiness in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda: a scoping review anchored in the 2026 Bundibugyo outbreak.
abstract: Abstract Background The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on 15 May 2026, and Uganda confirmed its first case the same day. Neither country had a licensed vaccine or treatment for the virus, yet the outbreak took very different courses in the two. This scoping review maps the evidence on their national preparedness instruments and health system readiness. Methods We followed the Arksey and O'Malley framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews. National instruments in force at the onset, International Health Regulations evaluations and outbreak documents were sought from the issuing bodies, verified and charted against 52 component requirements in ten dimensions, with operational specificity as an eleventh. A fixed rule assigned each country a four-level descriptor per dimension, and documented outbreak risks were mapped against the gaps. Results We included 57 sources, 15 of them national instruments. Uganda's instruments addressed 47 of 52 components (90.4%) and the DRC's 38 (73.1%), and 31.7% of Ugandan and 15.2% of Congolese provisions were highly specific. Uganda was rated higher in six dimensions, including surveillance, isolation capacity, displaced populations and accountability, and equal in five. Both were inadequate on cross-border governance, and neither had a Bundibugyo-specific countermeasure provision. In the 2023 Joint External Evaluations the mean indicator score was 2.75 in Uganda and 1.63 in the DRC (paired difference 1.13, 95% confidence interval 0.83 to 1.42). Uganda's outbreak ended with 20 confirmed cases, whereas the DRC had reported 7890 confirmed cases by 23 September. The DRC's response plan of May 2026 was highly specific in 21 of 37 provisions. Conclusions The two countries differed in standing capacity and in the specificity of their standing instruments. The DRC's highly specific response plan suggests that its gap lay in standing arrangements rather than in response planning. A documentary review cannot establish that these differences caused the different courses of the outbreak. Priorities are surveillance and isolation capacity in the DRC, cross-border governance in both countries and national pathways for investigational Bundibugyo products.

Uganda's instruments were more comprehensive, addressing 90.4% of the components, while the DRC's addressed 73.1%. Uganda was rated higher in six dimensions, including surveillance and accountability, and equal in five. The DRC's response plan was highly specific in 21 of 37 provisions, suggesting gaps in standing arrangements. Both countries lacked Bundibugyo-specific countermeasures and had inadequate cross-border governance. The review emphasizes the need for improved surveillance, isolation capacity, and cross-border coordination, as well as national pathways for investigational products.

elements_en.scope_and_question: This scoping review examines the national preparedness instruments and health system readiness of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda in the context of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak. The review focuses on the capacity of these countries to respond to the outbreak, including their surveillance systems, isolation capabilities, and provisions for managing displaced populations. The central question is how these countries' preparedness frameworks influenced the outbreak's trajectory.
elements_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review followed the Arksey and O'Malley framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance, and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews. National instruments in force at the outbreak's onset, International Health Regulations evaluations, and outbreak documents were sought from issuing bodies and charted against 52 component requirements across ten dimensions, with operational specificity as an eleventh.
elements_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that Uganda's national instruments addressed 47 of 52 components (90.4%), while the DRC's addressed 38 (73.1%). Uganda was rated higher in six dimensions, including surveillance, isolation capacity, displaced populations, and accountability, and equal in five. The DRC's response plan was highly specific in 21 of 37 provisions, indicating that its gap lay in standing arrangements rather than in response planning.
elements_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that both countries were inadequate in cross-border governance. Neither had a Bundibugyo-specific countermeasure provision. Additionally, the review notes that documentary analysis cannot establish causality between these differences and the varying outbreak courses.
elements_en.research_and_practice_implications: Priorities for research and practice include enhancing surveillance and isolation capacity in the DRC, improving cross-border governance in both countries, and developing national pathways for investigational Bundibugyo products.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本范围综述探讨了刚果民主共和国(DRC)和乌干达在2026年邦迪布古病毒病背景下的国家应对工具和卫生系统准备度。综述重点在于这些国家应对病毒病的能力,包括其抗病毒药物系统、隔离能力以及管理流动人口的条款。核心问题是这些国家的应对框架如何影响了病毒病的传播路径。

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述发现,乌干达的国家工具覆盖了52个组成部分中的47个(90.4%),而刚果民主共和国的国家工具覆盖了38个(73.1%)。在六个维度上,乌干达的评分高于刚果民主共和国,包括抗病毒药物系统、隔离能力、流动人口管理以及问责机制,而在五个维度上评分相同。刚果民主共和国的应对计划在37项条款中有21项具有高度具体性,表明其差距在于常规安排而非应对计划本身。

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究与实践的优先事项包括提升刚果民主共和国的抗病毒药物系统和隔离能力,改善两国的跨境治理,并制定针对研究性邦迪布古病毒产品的国家路径。

title_zh: 刚果民主共和国和乌干达的国家埃博拉病毒病应对政策架构及卫生系统准备度:一项基于2026年邦迪布古病毒病的范围综述
source_body_en: Abstract Background The 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) on 15 May 2026, and Uganda confirmed its first case the same day. Neither country had a licensed vaccine or treatment for the virus, yet the outbreak took very different courses in the two. This scoping review maps the evidence on their national preparedness instruments and health system readiness. Methods We followed the Arksey and O'Malley framework, Joanna Briggs Institute guidance and the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews. National instruments in force at the onset, International Health Regulations evaluations and outbreak documents were sought from the issuing bodies, verified and charted against 52 component requirements in ten dimensions, with operational specificity as an eleventh. A fixed rule assigned each country a four-level descriptor per dimension, and documented outbreak risks were mapped against the gaps. Results We included 57 sources, 15 of them national instruments. Uganda's instruments addressed 47 of 52 components (90.4%) and the DRC's 38 (73.1%), and 31.7% of Ugandan and 15.2% of Congolese provisions were highly specific. Uganda was rated higher in six dimensions, including surveillance, isolation capacity, displaced populations and accountability, and equal in five. Both were inadequate on cross-border governance, and neither had a Bundibugyo-specific countermeasure provision. In the 2023 Joint External Evaluations the mean indicator score was 2.75 in Uganda and 1.63 in the DRC (paired difference 1.13, 95% confidence interval 0.83 to 1.42). Uganda's outbreak ended with 20 confirmed cases, whereas the DRC had reported 7890 confirmed cases by 23 September. The DRC's response plan of May 2026 was highly specific in 21 of 37 provisions. Conclusions The two countries differed in standing capacity and in the specificity of their standing instruments. The DRC's highly specific response plan suggests that its gap lay in standing arrangements rather than in response planning. A documentary review cannot establish that these differences caused the different courses of the outbreak. Priorities are surveillance and isolation capacity in the DRC, cross-border governance in both countries and national pathways for investigational Bundibugyo products.

title: Private healthcare facilities’ participation in Uganda’s viral hemorrhagic fever surveillance program: contributions, selective case capture, and underutilized early-warning potential
abstract: Abstract Background Private healthcare facilities are important initial points of contact, especially for patients with undifferentiated febrile illnesses in mixed health systems. However, their contribution to viral hemorrhagic fever surveillance remains to be quantified, particularly in outbreak-prone regions. We assessed their contribution to Uganda’s national surveillance system and examined variation by case mix, geography, and outbreak period. Methods We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional analysis of all suspected VHF specimen submissions recorded in Uganda’s national Result Dispatch System from 1 January 2023 to 14 August 2026, spanning the 2025 Sudan virus disease and 2026 Ebola (Bundibugyo virus, BDBV) outbreaks. Ownership was classified against the national health facility master list. Pre-specified outcomes were test positivity, recorded bleeding, and alive-at-reporting status. Adjusted analyses used generalized linear mixed models with a district-level random intercept, pre-specified sensitivity analyses, and a test of effect modification by Kampala. Results Of 7,929 submissions, 504 (6.4%) were private. Private healthcare facilities contributed 21 of 149 VHF-positive submissions and 10 of 32 Ebola-positive submissions. During May–June 2026, they contributed 212 of 1,230 submissions and 10 of 20 Ebola-positive submissions; Ebola positivity was 4.72% versus 0.98% in public submissions (post-hoc comparison; crude odds ratio 4.99, p = 0.0007). Private ownership was associated with overall VHF positivity (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.44, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.95–6.05), recorded bleeding (4.97, 3.86–6.41), and alive-at-reporting status among known-status records (5.43, 4.09–7.21). Positivity attenuated after reporting-status adjustment (2.40, 1.34–4.28); intervals included 1 in alive-only and pre-2026 analyses. Bleeding remained associated after adjustment for symptom recording (3.85, 2.98–4.97). The alive-at-reporting association was stronger in Kampala but remained elevated elsewhere. All 16 initially significant symptom comparisons remained significant after false discovery rate adjustment. Conclusions Private healthcare facilities contributed a small share of submissions but a disproportionate share of detections, recorded VHF-compatible bleeding far more often, and far more often reported patients still alive, unlike the post-mortem case-finding dominating public submissions in the capital. This is consistent with an underused early-warning role and supports targeted, differentiated integration; establishing any effect on timeliness requires prospective study. Trial registration Clinical trial number: not applicable.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the role of private healthcare facilities in Uganda’s viral hemorrhagic fever surveillance system, particularly during outbreaks of Sudan virus disease and Ebola (Bundibugyo virus). Private ownership was associated with overall VHF positivity (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.44, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.95–6.05), recorded bleeding (4.97, 3.86–6.41), and alive-at-reporting status among known-status records (5.43, 4.09–7.21).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Private healthcare facilities contributed a small share of submissions but a disproportionate share of detections, recorded VHF-compatible bleeding far more often, and far more often reported patients still alive, unlike the post-mortem case-finding dominating public submissions in the capital.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support targeted, differentiated integration of private healthcare facilities into surveillance systems, highlighting their potential for early-warning and improved case detection in viral hemorrhagic fever outbreaks.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Positivity attenuated after reporting-status adjustment (2.40, 1.34–4.28); intervals included 1 in alive-only and pre-2026 analyses. The evidence is moderate as it is based on retrospective data and requires prospective study to confirm effects on timeliness.

title_zh: 乌干达私人医疗机构参与病毒性出血热监测计划的贡献、选择性病例捕获及未被充分利用的早期预警潜力
source_body_en: Abstract Background Private healthcare facilities are important initial points of contact, especially for patients with undifferentiated febrile illnesses in mixed health systems. However, their contribution to viral hemorrhagic fever surveillance remains to be quantified, particularly in outbreak-prone regions. We assessed their contribution to Uganda’s national surveillance system and examined variation by case mix, geography, and outbreak period. Methods We conducted a retrospective cross-sectional analysis of all suspected VHF specimen submissions recorded in Uganda’s national Result Dispatch System from 1 January 2023 to 14 August 2026, spanning the 2025 Sudan virus disease and 2026 Ebola (Bundibugyo virus, BDBV) outbreaks. Ownership was classified against the national health facility master list. Pre-specified outcomes were test positivity, recorded bleeding, and alive-at-reporting status. Adjusted analyses used generalized linear mixed models with a district-level random intercept, pre-specified sensitivity analyses, and a test of effect modification by Kampala. Results Of 7,929 submissions, 504 (6.4%) were private. Private healthcare facilities contributed 21 of 149 VHF-positive submissions and 10 of 32 Ebola-positive submissions. During May–June 2026, they contributed 212 of 1,230 submissions and 10 of 20 Ebola-positive submissions; Ebola positivity was 4.72% versus 0.98% in public submissions (post-hoc comparison; crude odds ratio 4.99, p = 0.0007). Private ownership was associated with overall VHF positivity (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.44, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.95–6.05), recorded bleeding (4.97, 3.86–6.41), and alive-at-reporting status among known-status records (5.43, 4.09–7.21). Positivity attenuated after reporting-status adjustment (2.40, 1.34–4.28); intervals included 1 in alive-only and pre-2026 analyses. Bleeding remained associated after adjustment for symptom recording (3.85, 2.98–4.97). The alive-at-reporting association was stronger in Kampala but remained elevated elsewhere. All 16 initially significant symptom comparisons remained significant after false discovery rate adjustment. Conclusions Private healthcare facilities contributed a small share of submissions but a disproportionate share of detections, recorded VHF-compatible bleeding far more often, and far more often reported patients still alive, unlike the post-mortem case-finding dominating public submissions in the capital. This is consistent with an underused early-warning role and supports targeted, differentiated integration; establishing any effect on timeliness requires prospective study. Trial registration Clinical trial number: not applicable.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 私人医疗机构是重要初始接触点,特别是在混合医疗体系中,对于患有非特异性发热疾病的患者尤为重要。然而,其在病毒性出血热监测中的贡献尚未量化,尤其是在暴发高发地区。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们回顾性地分析了乌干达国家结果分发系统中从2023年1月1日到2026年8月14日记录的所有疑似VHF样本提交,涵盖了2025年苏丹病毒病和2026年埃博拉(邦迪布古病毒,BDBV)暴发。在7,929份提交中,有504份(6.4%)来自私人机构。
analysis_zh.methods: 所有权根据国家医疗机构主清单进行分类。预设的结局包括检测阳性、记录出血和报告时存活状态。调整后的分析使用了带有区级随机截距的广义线性混合模型、预设的敏感性分析以及通过坎帕拉进行的效果修饰检验。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 私人医疗机构贡献了少量的提交,但检测比例却不成比例地高,记录了更多的VHF相容性出血,并更频繁地报告患者仍存活,这与首都公共提交中以死后病例发现为主的情况不同。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持将私人医疗机构有针对性、差异化地整合到监测系统中,突出了其在病毒性出血热暴发中的早期预警潜力和改善病例检测的前景。

title: A Clearer Strategy for Responding to the Ebola Bundibugyo Outbreak Is Needed
abstract: The ongoing Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by Orthoebolavirus bundibugyoense (BDBV) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo highlights persistent gaps in global outbreak preparedness. Despite decades of experience with Ebola, delayed detection, limited access to care, insecurity, community mistrust, and fragmented response systems continue to hinder effective control and reduce survival. While non-pharmaceutical interventions remain essential, potentially effective medical countermeasures should be considered earlier. Existing vaccines and therapeutics developed against Ebola Zaire, although not licensed for BDBV, could be evaluated through carefully governed investigational or compassionate use alongside rigorous research. Effective response also requires strengthened surveillance, decentralized care, community engagement, and meaningful leadership by local scientists and healthcare professionals. This outbreak underscores the need for an adaptive, locally led, and internationally supported strategy that simultaneously saves lives and generates evidence.

abstract_zh: 刚果民主共和国持续发生的由正埃博拉病毒邦迪布古亚种(BDBV)引起的暴发暴发凸显了全球暴发应对准备工作的持续不足。尽管已有数十年应对埃博拉病毒的经验,但检测延迟、医疗资源获取受限、安全局势不稳定、社区信任缺失以及应对系统碎片化等问题仍持续阻碍有效控制并降低生存率。虽然非药物干预措施仍然是关键,但可能有效的医疗应对措施应更早考虑。针对埃博拉扎伊尔亚种开发的现有疫苗和治疗药物,尽管未获准用于BDBV,但仍可通过严格监管的试验性或同情使用评估,同时结合严谨的研究。有效的应对还需要加强监测、分散医疗护理、加强社区参与以及由本地科学家和医疗专业人员提供有意义的领导。此次暴发突显了需要一种适应性强、以本地为主导并得到国际支持的策略,以同时挽救生命并产生证据。

title: Strengthening Disease Surveillance, Outbreak Preparedness, and Response Through Medical Laboratory Systems in Nigeria: Roles, Requirements, and Post-Ebola Reforms
abstract: The 2014 Ebola Virus Disease epidemic in west Africa revealed how fragile diagnostic and surveillance infrastructure can be, while Nigeria’s containment of its imported cases showed what rapid laboratory confirmation can achieve. This review explore the role of medical laboratory systems to disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness, with emphasis on laboratory strengthening in Nigeria. The Ebola experience prompted major institutional and technical reforms, including the strengthening of the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control, expansion of reference and molecular testing laboratories, and establishment of emergency operations centres. The review concludes that reliable laboratory systems are central to detecting infectious disease threats early and guiding a coordinated public health response required to sustain health security
journal: Interdisciplinary Journal of the African Alliance for Research Advocacy and Innovation

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the role of medical laboratory systems in disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness, particularly in the context of Ebola viruses and related entities. The central question is how strengthening these systems can improve early detection and response to infectious disease threats, with a specific emphasis on Nigeria's experience post-Ebola.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative analysis of the role of medical laboratory systems in disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness, with an emphasis on the Ebola Virus Disease epidemic in West Africa and Nigeria's containment efforts. It does not report on specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that reliable laboratory systems are central to detecting infectious disease threats early and guiding a coordinated public health response required to sustain health security. It highlights the importance of rapid laboratory confirmation in containing outbreaks, as demonstrated by Nigeria's success in managing imported Ebola cases.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while the Ebola experience prompted major institutional and technical reforms, the evidence does not provide detailed information on the effectiveness of these reforms or their long-term impact on disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness. There is also a lack of specific data on the comparative performance of different laboratory systems.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for continued investment in strengthening medical laboratory systems to enhance disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness. It suggests that future research should focus on evaluating the effectiveness of these systems and addressing gaps in their implementation and performance.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines the critical role of medical laboratory systems in disease surveillance and outbreak preparedness, particularly in the context of Ebola viruses and related entities. It highlights the 2014 Ebola Virus Disease epidemic in West Africa as a case study, showing how fragile diagnostic infrastructure can be, while Nigeria's successful containment of imported cases demonstrates the value of rapid laboratory confirmation. The review concludes that robust laboratory systems are essential for early detection and coordinated public health responses. It also identifies evidence gaps, such as the lack of detailed data on the effectiveness of reforms and comparative performance of different systems, and suggests future research priorities to address these gaps and improve health security.

elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述强调需要持续投资以加强医疗实验室系统,从而提高疾病监测和暴发的准备能力。它建议未来的研究应集中在评估这些系统的有效性,并解决其实施和表现方面的空白。}}.{

abstract_zh: 2014年西非埃博拉病毒病疫情暴露了诊断和监测基础设施的脆弱性,而尼日利亚对输入病例的控制则展示了快速实验室确认所能实现的效果。本综述探讨了医疗实验室系统在疾病监测和暴发准备中的作用,特别强调了尼日利亚实验室系统的加强。埃博拉疫情促使了重大机构和技术改革,包括加强尼日利亚疾病控制中心、扩展参考和分子检测实验室以及建立应急行动中心。综述得出结论,可靠的实验室系统对于早期发现传染病威胁和指导协调的公共卫生应对措施以维持健康安全至关重要。

title: Working harder, losing ground: surveillance under epidemic load in the first three months of the 2026 Bundibugyo outbreak in the DR Congo, a retrospective analysis of situation reports
abstract: Abstract Background Situation-report counts reflect both transmission and surveillance-system performance. We quantified operational performance under rising workload during the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and tested whether testing volume explained short-term case-count variation. Methods Retrospective longitudinal analysis of public DRC INSP situation reports and the INRB-UMIE BDBV2026-Data repository: 89 national reporting dates through 31 August 2026, with operational indicators through 26 August. Report-day proportions were modelled with beta-binomial regression, counts and laboratory throughput with negative-binomial regression, and strict positivity with province-by-time interactions; case/testing associations used true 24-hour intervals only. Results Alert volume increased 81% per 30 days in standardised regimes (incidence-rate ratio [IRR] 1.81, 95% CI 1.58–2.08) while alert-investigation coverage declined (odds ratio [OR] 0.50, 0.34–0.73). Validated-suspect yield declined per total alert volume (OR 0.80, 0.69–0.93) but not among investigated alerts (OR 0.86, 0.71–1.03). Contact follow-up improved (OR 1.55, 1.37–1.76) and reported laboratory throughput increased (IRR 1.56, 1.41–1.73). Positivity fell in Ituri (OR 0.79, 0.68–0.92) but rose in Nord-Kivu (OR 1.36, 1.04–1.78; interaction p = 0.003). Sixteen multi-day intervals contained 42% of cumulative reported case growth. Testing correlated with 24-hour case increments before calendar-time adjustment (Spearman ρ=0.41) but not after (IRR per doubling 1.01, 0.96–1.06). Conclusions Surveillance and diagnostic activity scaled up, but alert-investigation coverage fell as workload rose while contact follow-up improved. Unequal reporting intervals shaped the administrative curve; testing volume did not independently explain short-term case counts.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how surveillance and diagnostic systems perform under increasing epidemic workload, particularly during the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective longitudinal analysis was conducted using public DRC INSP situation reports and the INRB-UMIE BDBV2026-Data repository, covering 89 national reporting dates through 31 August 2026.
analysis.methods: The study used beta-binomial regression to model report-day proportions, negative-binomial regression for counts and laboratory throughput, and province-by-time interactions to assess strict positivity. Case/testing associations were based on true 24-hour intervals only.
analysis.main_results: Alert volume increased by 81% per 30 days (IRR 1.81, 95% CI 1.58–2.08), while alert-investigation coverage declined (OR 0.50, 0.34–0.73). Contact follow-up improved (OR 1.55, 1.37–1.76) and laboratory throughput increased (IRR 1.56, 1.41–1.73).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that surveillance and diagnostic activity scaled up, but alert-investigation coverage fell as workload increased, while contact follow-up improved. This highlights the complex relationship between testing volume and case reporting during an epidemic.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for adaptive surveillance strategies during outbreaks, emphasizing the importance of maintaining alert-investigation coverage despite rising workloads.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on situation reports and the potential for unequal reporting intervals to shape the administrative curve. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on retrospective analysis and does not account for real-time data.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the performance of surveillance and diagnostic systems during the 2026 Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. It found that alert volume increased significantly, but alert-investigation coverage decreased as workload rose. Contact follow-up and laboratory throughput improved, but the relationship between testing volume and case counts was not independent. The study highlights the challenges of maintaining effective surveillance during epidemics and suggests the need for adaptive strategies. However, the findings are based on retrospective data and may be influenced by unequal reporting intervals, limiting their strength.

title: Ebola Bundibugyo reaches Nigeria: implications for global travel, Hajj and Umrah.
abstract: An imported Bundibugyo virus disease case in Nigeria underscores the need for rapid recognition, contact tracing, laboratory readiness, and cross-border coordination. Updated evidence shows no onward Nigerian transmission in the reported follow-up, while Saudi Arabia’s Kenya-specific restrictions highlight the balance between proportionate travel measures and preparedness for Hajj and Umrah.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚输入性邦迪布古病毒病例对全球旅行、朝觐和副朝的影响,强调了快速识别、接触者追踪、实验室准备和跨境协调的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究报告了尼日利亚输入性邦迪布古病毒病例,并分析了沙特阿拉伯针对该病毒输入所实施的肯尼亚特定旅行限制对旅行措施和朝觐、副朝准备的影响。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究依赖于关于尼日利亚病例的最新证据,并分析了沙特阿拉伯为应对邦迪布古病毒输入而实施的旅行限制。
elements_zh.main_results: 证据表明,在报告的随访期间,尼日利亚未出现邦迪布古病毒的进一步传播,而沙特阿拉伯的旅行限制则突显了旅行措施与宗教朝觐准备之间的平衡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明在面对新兴病毒威胁时,保持警惕和为全球旅行及宗教活动做好准备的重要性,未报告新的致病机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,需要加强跨境监测和协调,以管理病毒输入的风险,并确保朝觐和副朝等大型聚集活动的准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于摘要信息,可能限制分析的深度,而研究结果得到了最新证据和旅行限制的支持,结论具有中等可信度。

title: Development of Heterocyclic Small Molecule Antiviral Entry Inhibitors
abstract: There is an urgent need to develop novel antiviral therapeutics to address the growing threat posed by viruses. Small-molecule inhibitors of viral entry are attractive antiviral agents because they block the virus at its earliest step, preventing the virus from entering host cells and causing downstream damage. Some of the viruses of greatest concern for human health, such as human immunodeficiency virus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza virus, Ebola virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, and Lassa virus, encode Class 1 fusion proteins which mediate membrane fusion and viral entry. In this dissertation, we highlight recent advances in the discovery and development of small-molecule entry inhibitors reported over the past five years that target viruses encoding Class 1 fusion proteins. Additionally, we report thieno[3,2-b]pyrroles as novel Group 2 influenza A virus entry inhibitors. Lastly, we report the further optimization of the raloxifene‐inspired benzothiophenes scaffold as novel pan-filovirus entry inhibitors.

title: Cytoplasmic ATR orchestrates PRRSV and EBOV replication organelle assembly via vimentin phosphorylation
abstract: The ataxia telangiectasia-mutated and Rad3-related (ATR) kinase is a well-established master regulator of the DNA damage response and replication stress. In this study, we uncover an unexpected, conserved role of ATR in promoting the replication of two distinct RNA viruses-an arterivirus and a filovirus-through vimentin phosphorylation. Acute pharmacologic inhibition or knockdown of ATR robustly suppress viral replication and sharply reduce the formation of double-membrane vesicles and membrane-less condensates that serve as replication organelles (ROs) for these divergent viral classes. Notably, although ATR is recruited to cytoplasmic ROs throughout the viral life cycle, it acts specifically at the replication stage without affecting viral attachment, entry, or egress. We further show that ATR directly interacts with and phosphorylates vimentin within ROs, driving vimentin rearrangement and delineating RO boundaries. Mechanistically, ATR-dependent phosphorylation of vimentin at Ser459 is indispensable for RO formation during infection by both PRRSV and EBOV. Together, these findings reveal a conserved ATR-vimentin signaling axis that promotes RO biogenesis across diverse RNA viruses, defining a noncanonical function of cytoplasmic ATR in orchestrating the assembly of both membrane-bound and membrane-less replication compartments via vimentin phosphorylation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the role of ATR in viral replication, particularly in the context of RNA viruses, and to address the knowledge gap regarding its noncanonical functions beyond the DNA damage response.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focused on the replication of two distinct RNA viruses, PRRSV and EBOV, and examined the role of ATR in their life cycle, specifically during the replication stage.
analysis.methods: The researchers used acute pharmacologic inhibition or knockdown of ATR to assess its impact on viral replication and RO formation, and they demonstrated ATR's direct interaction with and phosphorylation of vimentin within ROs.
analysis.main_results: Acute inhibition or knockdown of ATR significantly suppressed viral replication and reduced the formation of double-membrane vesicles and membrane-less condensates essential for ROs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal a conserved ATR-vimentin signaling axis that promotes RO biogenesis across diverse RNA viruses, highlighting a novel noncanonical function of cytoplasmic ATR in orchestrating replication compartments.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of viral replication and may inform the development of antiviral strategies targeting ATR-vimentin interactions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro observations and does not address in vivo relevance, but the evidence is robust and consistent across both PRRSV and EBOV infections.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of ATR in RNA virus replication, revealing a conserved mechanism through which ATR promotes the formation of replication organelles (ROs) by phosphorylating vimentin. The research demonstrates that ATR inhibition or knockdown suppresses viral replication and reduces RO formation in both PRRSV and EBOV. These findings highlight a novel noncanonical function of ATR in orchestrating the assembly of replication compartments, which could inform future antiviral strategies. However, the study is limited to in vitro settings and does not explore in vivo implications. The evidence is strong and consistent across both viral models, suggesting a broad relevance to RNA virus biology.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨ATR在病毒复制中的作用,特别是在RNA病毒的背景下,并解决其在DNA损伤反应之外的非典型功能方面的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究聚焦于两种不同的RNA病毒PRRSV和EBOV的复制,并考察了ATR在其生命周期中的作用,特别是在复制阶段。

title: Characterizing the Biological Roles of the Arenavirus Exoribonuclease (exoN) in a Tri-Segmented Pichinde Virus System
abstract: Arenaviruses such as Lassa virus (LASV) and Junin virus (JUNV) can cause lethal hemorrhagic fever diseases with no FDA-approved vaccines or effective therapeutics. The arenaviral nucleoprotein (NP) contains an exoribonuclease (exoN) domain that suppresses type I interferon (IFN-I) production by degrading pathogen-associated molecular-pattern (PAMP) RNAs. The biological roles of NP exoN during viral infection have not been well characterized for highly pathogenic arenaviruses, largely due to biosafety constraints and challenges in generating viable NP exoN mutants. We previously developed a recombinant tri-segmented viral vector (rP18tri) based on non-pathogenic Pichinde virus (PICV), which allows functional studies of transgenes during arenavirus infection in a BSL-2 setting. In this study, we introduced point mutations at individual catalytic residues to abolish PICV NP exoN activity and generated exoN-deficient rP18tri(NPm) reporter viruses. These mutants failed to replicate in IFN-competent A549 cells, accompanied by strong IFN-I induction. Expression of wild-type (WT) JUNV NP, but not its exoN-deficient mutant, in the rP18tri(NPm)-G backbone restored single-cycle infectivity and suppressed IFN-I induction. Furthermore, exoN-deficient viruses produced disproportionately high levels of defective virion particles relative to virion RNA from infected A549 cells, a defect that was rescued by expression of WT JUNV NP but not the exoN-deficient NP as a transgene. Together, these data demonstrate an essential role of NP exoN in IFN-I suppression and identify a novel biological function of NP exoN in promoting the production of infectious virion particles in IFN-competent cells. Importance: Arenaviruses, such as Junin virus (JUNV), can cause severe viral hemorrhagic fever in humans, with no FDA-approved vaccines or effective therapeutics. Arenaviral nucleoprotein (NP) contains an exoribonuclease domain (exoN), which helps to evade the host immune system by blocking the production of type I interferons (IFNs). However, the biological role of NP exoN in arenavirus infection is not well understood. In this study, we used a recombinant, tri-segmented non-pathogenic Pichinde virus (PICV) with NP exoN mutations as a safe and infectious arenavirus vector to express JUNV NP as a transgene. We found that JUNV NP exoN plays a key role in suppressing IFN-I responses and discovered a previously unrecognized function of exoN in producing infectious virion particles in IFN-competent cells. These findings improve our understanding of arenavirus infection and identify NP exoN as a promising target for developing new antiviral therapies.
